reason: A web search and browsing plugin for DeepSeek Harness that provides multi-engine search, webpage fetching, platform-specific search, time filtering, and configurable provider credentials.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多引擎网页搜索、网页内容抓取、平台搜索、时间过滤和搜索引擎配置功能。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with multi-engine web search, webpage fetching, platform-specific search, time filtering, and configurable search providers.

capabilities: Searches the web through multiple external search providers
Fetches and extracts content from specified web pages
Searches public platform APIs including GitHub, Reddit, npm, and Wikipedia
Stores configurable provider settings and API keys
Uses external network services and supports provider fallback
